Barua’s study of the Indian thought before the Buddha and its schools, as the background to the history of Buddhist philosophy (Calcutta, 1918). Listed in the catalogue of the Rare Book Society of India.

From Internet Archive · Public domain in India

Scanned from a copy in the University of California Libraries; hosted by the Internet Archive. Item: Prolegomena to a history of Buddhist philosophy · Barua, Beni Madhab, 1888-1948 · 1918, 66 scanned pages. Published 1918; Beni Madhab Barua died 1948; public domain in India.

This book is not stored in this library: its pages are shown from the Internet Archive when they are opened, in this library's own viewer, and each chapter ends with this credit. The pages are shown as scans in this library's viewer (zoom, pan, thumbnails); the machine reading of these scans is not good enough to be shown as text.
